Name: OMONOIA FC
Company description: OMONOIA is the most successful and popular club in Cyprus since 1948. Its following is spread across the island, something which sets it apart from all other clubs. Before joining CFA, OMONOIA has won 4 Championships and 5 Cups in KEPO. OMONOIA remains the only team to have won the Cypriot Cup 4 times in a row. THE COMMITMENT  OMONOIA FC is managed by a dedicated group of people who are committed to evolving the team through a professional approach towards a more modernized model of operations. This translates into a higher Return on Investment to sponsors with an effort on building long-term strategic partnerships.  OMONOIA holds the record for the highest average attendance in a season which amounts to 11,003 tickets per game. Added to that, OMONOIA also holds the record with the highest season ticket sales of 11100 in a season.
